title: Stalks commute with total tensor products of sheaf complexes
statement: Let $(X,\mathcal O_X)$ be a ringed space, let $F^\bullet$ and $K^\bullet$ be complexes of sheaves of $\mathcal O_X$-modules [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules], and let $x\in X$. There is a natural isomorphism of complexes of $\mathcal O_{X,x}$-modules $(F^\bullet\otimes_{\mathcal O_X}K^\bullet)_x \cong F_x^\bullet\otimes_{\mathcal O_{X,x}}K_x^\bullet$ for the total tensor construction [def-pc-tensor-complex-sheaves], where both sides use the total-complex direct sums and tensor differential.
